concept.visionDesc: Eden Connexion is not just a dating site. It is a digital sanctuary dedicated to building strong Christian homes, based on truth, respect, and divine love.
concept.ethicsDesc: We believe that every interaction should be imbued with respect. Our ethical charter bans casual behavior and encourages sincerity from the very first exchanges.
concept.excellenceDesc: Every profile is carefully verified. Our matching algorithm prioritizes spiritual affinities and shared values for solid unions.
concept.communityDesc: Join a community of committed Christians who share your vision of marriage and family according to Scripture.
concept.quote: The blessed union begins with a true encounter.
concept.moderatedCommDesc: Our system automatically blocks sharing of external links and phone numbers during initial messages to protect you from scams.
concept.realtimeVerificationDesc: Our verification compares your profile photo with your ID to ensure you are who you claim to be.

parcours.heroDesc: Eden Connexion accompanies you step by step in your quest for a blessed union, combining modern technology and timeless biblical values.
parcours.step1Desc: Beyond physical criteria, you define your spiritual vision: denomination, parish involvement, and Christian life projects.
parcours.step1Detail: Use our AI assistant to refine your description and align it with your deepest values.
parcours.step2Desc: Security is our priority. Every member is invited to verify their identity to guarantee profile authenticity.
parcours.step2Detail: A certification badge is awarded to verified profiles, establishing a climate of sacred trust.
parcours.step3Desc: Our algorithm prioritizes spiritual affinities. Browse profiles that share your vision of alliance and family.
parcours.step3Detail: Access advanced filters by country, education level, and religious practice.
parcours.step4Desc: Start a conversation in a respectful setting. Our AI moderation ensures courtesy and prevents inappropriate behavior.
parcours.step4Detail: Communication focused on the marriage project, far from the superficiality of traditional social networks.
parcours.ctaDesc: Love is a gift, but meeting is a choice. Choose sincerity and faith today.
